Since ext4 was converted to the new mount API
mount option isn't being handled entirely correctly
fscrypt_set_test_dummy_encryption() helper function combines
parsing/checking/applying into one function.  That doesn't work well
with the new mount API
column2: which split these into separate steps.

column1: This was sort of okay anyway
column2: due to the parsing logic that was copied

column1: from fscrypt_set_test_dummy_encryption() into ext4_parse_param()
combined with an additional check in ext4_check_test_dummy_encryption().
However
column2: these overlooked the case of changing the value of

column1: test_dummy_encryption on remount
column2: which isn't allowed but ext4 wasn't

column1: detecting until ext4_apply_options() when it's too late to fail.
Another bug is that if test_dummy_encryption was specified multiple
times with an argument
Fix this up properly by using the new helper functions that allow
splitting up the parse/check/apply steps for test_dummy_encryption.
